criteria.name: Identity and source crosswalk
criteria.assessment: Current Indiana Delta contact and the 2010 national magazine independently identify 1307 Tower Drive; Purdue FID 856 carries the exact address and Greek owner but stale Phi Kappa Tau name.

criteria.name: Structural footprint and local placement
criteria.assessment: The asset includes the FID 856 structural wall ring in its documented local centroid frame. Source outline area is 421.96 m² and dimensions about 34.74 × 28.28 m. The nearby OSM outline is correctly treated as broader roof/eave extent, not substituted as the wall ring.

criteria.name: Overall massing and roof silhouette
criteria.assessment: The front Georgian composition and broad pitched roof read clearly. The rear now has the projecting central bay, raised cross-gable and roof stack seen in contractor photo 3. Exact roof pitch, story count and stack height remain photo-based estimates; model top is about 18.15 m above local datum versus legacy GIS extrusion near 53 ft.

criteria.name: Facade composition and architectural detail
criteria.assessment: Front portico, central pediment and ΦΚΨ mark, balcony, brick wings, repeated window courses, pale trim, projecting rear bay, paired upper openings and lower windows are source-consistent. Fine service features, downspouts and detailed roof intersections remain generalized.

criteria.name: Materials and texture
criteria.assessment: Procedural running-bond brick and varied dark roof material render coherently with pale trim. Contractor references are monochrome, so red-brown brick color remains plausible rather than directly verified.

criteria.name: Interior
criteria.assessment: The cutaway now conveys the photographed lounge/common room and adjacent stair hall: defined walls and arched opening, extended stair/landing/guard, upper schematic room divisions, shelves, seating, and dining/coffee tables. The furniture and circulation broadly match photos 5–6, but the plan, dimensions and upper layout are schematic; the image composition has some clutter/occlusion.

criteria.name: Asset integrity and portability
criteria.assessment: Fresh-open in Blender 5.2.3 succeeded. Expected scene/collection, 969 objects and no external image dependencies were independently confirmed.

evidence.summary: Blender 5.2.3 independently opened the exact SHA; expected scene/collection; 969 objects; bounds X[-17.802,17.774], Y[-14.614,15.169], Z[-0.520,18.150] m; no external images.
FID 856 polygon: 421.96 m², approx 34.74 × 28.28 m; EPSG:3857 inverse Web Mercator followed by repository local conversion.
Official chapter contact page, national magazine evidence, Purdue GIS FID 856 and preserved contractor gallery record source identity and ambiguities.
Compared front, rear, lounge, and stair/lobby against corresponding asset renders in audit/phi_kappa_psi_fid856/renders/.

findings.finding: The previously missing rear central projection, window rhythm, cross-gable/shingle infill and roof stack have been modeled and are legible in the rear render.
The interior revision adds recognizable walls, room boundaries, stair circulation, a landing/guard, and lounge furnishings supported by contractor photos 5–6.

Interior plan, room dimensions, furnishing placement, exact vertical story interpretation, and roof/stack heights remain estimated or schematic because no architectural plan or surveyed elevation is available.

The GIS identity attribute conflicts with current chapter evidence (FID 856 says Phi Kappa Tau; address and owner agree with Phi Kappa Psi). The model’s top is above the legacy GIS 53 ft extrusion; the height conflict remains unresolved.
Contractor photographs establish major forms but do not state capture dates; their grayscale appearance does not verify brick hue.
